metadata.title: Contrasting Profiles of Low-Performing Mathematics Students in Public and Private Schools in the Philippines: Insights from Machine Learning

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value for analysis, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without accounting for school clustering, as there is no mention of multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions using cross-validation and other internal validation methods, indicating that it did not validate its findings on an external dataset.
